info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Cashflow Business Insights API
info.description: The Cashflow Business Insights API enables organizations to submit cash flow data for specific customers, facilitating detailed decision-making processes. By allowing integration of financial insights, businesses can better assess customer financial health and viability. This API is essential for financial analysts and decision-makers looking to enhance their understanding of cash flow patterns. Typical use cases include generating reports, evaluating loan applications, and conducting risk assessments based on submitted cash flow data.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new cashflow entry for a specific customer identified by their ID (CUST-100045). This action is essential for tracking the financial transactions associated with the customer.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create or update cash flow business records for the specified customer. It accepts a JSON payload that conforms to the defined schema.
